newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to name power privatization advisers by May.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to name power privatization advisers by May.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) will announce the winners of a contract to consult on the privatization of power generators Eletrosul and Furnas by the end of May, Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said on Thursday.

The selected consultants will provide advice on how to sell the companies and assess their value. The development bank hopes to have tender details for their sale ready by the end of the year, Kandir told reporters.
Furnas and Eletrosul, which belong to federal power holding Eletrobras, are expected to be privatized in 1998.

Within 15 days, the development bank also plans to invite consultants to submit bids for contracts to advise on the sale of Eletrobras' other two generating companies, Eletronorte and Chesf, Kandir said.
Brazil has sold its federally owned distribution companies, Escelsa and Light, but has yet to begin privatizing its generating assets.
